description: This PHP source file defines the ChannelsApiController class within the Goteo project's API controllers. It provides API endpoints for listing channels and uploading images related to categories, including permission checks and data retrieval from Node models.

classes.name: ChannelsApiController
classes.description: Controller class handling API requests for listing channels and uploading category images, with permission checks and JSON responses.

methods.name: channelsAction
methods.description: Handles requests to list channels, applies filters based on permissions, and returns a JSON response with channel data.

methods.name: uploadImagesAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX image upload requests for categories, enforcing permission checks and returning upload results as JSON.
